lines.say: GS4 tells you exactly which values it is looking for.

beats.say: GS4 tells you exactly which values it is looking for. They're written into the syllabus.

lines.say: Integrity, impartiality, non-partisanship. Objectivity, and dedication to public service.
And empathy, tolerance and compassion towards the weaker sections.

beats.say: Integrity, impartiality, non-partisanship. Objectivity, and dedication to public service. And empathy, tolerance and compassion towards the weaker sections.

lines.say: Impartiality means being fair to every citizen.
Non-partisanship means staying neutral between parties, whoever is in power.

data.text: Impartial: fair to every citizen. Non-partisan: neutral between political parties.
